title: Celestial Weaver
description: A woman in a flowing dark blue robe sits in the center of a cosmic landscape, her hands outstretched as glowing threads of light connect her to a wolf on the left and a large bird on the right. The scene features a starry night sky with constellations, a beam of light from above, glowing lotus-like flowers, and swirling patterns on the ground.
prompt: A mystical woman with long flowing hair sits cross-legged in a dark blue embroidered robe on a cosmic shore, her hands extended as she weaves glowing threads of light that connect to a blue wolf standing to her left and a large starry raven to her right, surrounded by glowing lotus flowers and swirling energy patterns on the ground, dramatic beam of light shining down from a starry night sky filled with constellations and nebulae, ethereal fantasy atmosphere
